_note: What you see: The connections part of the admin settings: telephony, incoming messages, providers and sending budgets.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Het deel koppelingen van de beheerinstellingen: telefonie, binnenkomende berichten, aanbieders en verzendbudgetten, en verder de uitslag van de verbindingstest per aanbieder (Bereikbaar met de badge mock mode; niet getest; de oorzaak als de bron of de leaf ontbreekt), de WhatsApp-sjablonen met in afwachting, goedgekeurd en afgekeurd met de reden en de laatste sync, en de Berichtenbox-sjablonen per zaaktype en status met variabelen en het voorbeeld.
de koppelingen: telefonie, berichten, xW: the connections: telephony, messages, xWiki and Shillinq
Stel het telefonieplatform in voor scher: Set up the telephony platform for screen pops and click to call.
Sms- en WhatsApp-providers roepen Pipeli: SMS and WhatsApp providers call Pipelinq without a Nextcloud login. If the signature is valid, Pipelinq stores what they send under the account below.
Serviceaccount voor sms en WhatsApp: Service account for SMS and WhatsApp
Binnenkomende berichten, gesprekken, STO: Incoming messages, conversations, STOP replies and messages from unknown numbers are stored under this account. It joins the group pipelinq-messaging, which may create and change messages, conversations and contact moments.
Binnenkomende berichten worden nu opgesl: Incoming messages are now stored as pipelinq-berichten.
Afzenders voor WhatsApp en sms. Sleutels: Senders for WhatsApp and SMS. Keys live with the source in OpenConnector (sourceId), never here.
Getest 3 nov 09:40 zonder kosten: de aan: Tested 3 Nov 09:40 at no cost: the provider answers in trial mode, no message was sent.
Test mislukt: bron twilio-sms ontbreekt: Test failed: source twilio-sms is missing in OpenConnector. Without the SMS leaf the provider falls back to logging only.
Per-provider send caps. Hard stop refuse: Per-provider send caps. Hard stop refuses further sends past the cap; alert-only just notifies once per period.
Kopie van de WhatsApp-sjablonen bij de a: Copy of the WhatsApp templates at the provider. The approval (pending, approved, rejected) and the sync time come from the provider; you create templates there, not here. Last sync: 7 Oct 2026, 06:00, every night.
7 okt 2026, 06:00 · reden van Meta: prom: 7 Oct 2026, 06:00 · reason from Meta: promotional text in a service template
Berichten naar de Berichtenbox van MijnO: Messages to the MijnOverheid message box per case type and status. Every template has fixed variables; the preview shows what the resident receives.
Voorbeeld: Paspoortaanvraag, status Afge: Preview: Passport application, status Completed, with the variables of case 2026-4871 filled in
Beste mevrouw De Vries, uw aanvraag 2026: Dear Mrs De Vries, your application 2026-4871 has been completed. You can collect your passport from 6 November at the front desk in the town hall. Bring your old passport.
Verstuurd via de Berichtenbox zodra de z: Sent through the message box as soon as the case reaches Completed. Without a template for a status no message goes out.
Stel de xWiki-kennisbank in die de dashb: Set up the xWiki knowledge base used by the dashboard widget and the sidebar tabs. Pipelinq finds xWiki via the xWiki app or via OpenRegister.
Ruimte die de dashboardwidget vooraf kie: Space the dashboard widget preselects. Leave empty to search all spaces.
Hoe lang zoekresultaten en pagina's op d: How long search results and pages are kept on the server. Default: 300.
Het HTTPS-adres waarop Shillinq goedgeke: The HTTPS address where Shillinq receives approved hours. Leave empty to turn the hand-over off.
Webhook-URL voor onderhanden werk in Shi: Webhook URL for work in progress in Shillinq
Goedgekeurde uren als conceptfacturen na: Send approved hours to Shillinq as draft invoices
Beheergroep voor overdracht naar facture: Admin group for hand-over to invoicing
Nextcloud-groep die 'Naar facturering st: Nextcloud group that may use 'Send to invoicing'. Leave empty to restrict this to Nextcloud administrators.
Vul de webhook-URL in voor de crediteure: Enter the webhook URL for the payables connection with Shillinq. Leave empty to keep it off.
